correctness.rationale: The printed stochastic equations have drifts A(y,z)x, B(x,z)y, C(x,y)z and common multiplicative sigma x/y/z dW. Each coordinate axis is invariant by pathwise uniqueness, and restriction is geometric Brownian motion dX=a_i X dt+sigma X dW. For every p>0, exact p-moment exponent p a_i +[p(p-1)/2]sigma² makes a_i+(p-1)sigma²/2<0 necessary for p-th-moment exponential stability for all small axis states. For printed Parameter Set 1, a_x=0.2*10*0.1+2-5=-2.8 and Eq16–18 restricted to x-axis are -2.8x<=-x, 0<=0, 0<=0. With sigma=3, E[x_t²]=x0² exp(3.4t) while almost-sure log exponent -7.3, disproving a noise-independent criterion on that invariant boundary. Independently computed exact rational coefficients a_x=-14/5, a_y=-9/5, a_z=-1/2 and second-moment exponent 17/5. A qualification is that pointwise source inequalities tested on x-axis are NOT a proof they hold throughout a 3D neighborhood; counterexample precisely addresses source no-noise drift test on invariant axis, not a global verification of an alternate neighborhood-uniform premise.
residual_risks: Mean-square failure does not refute pathwise almost-sure stability, finite-time simulations, or a theorem with additional unprinted restrictions on sigma.
The source moment order is not explicit in the quoted sentence; p=2 is the standard meaningful interpretation and is proved as a counterexample.
Boundary initial conditions are within nonnegative state space and x-axis. Global neighborhood validity of all three printed drift inequalities is not asserted.

originality.rationale: Geometric Brownian p-moments and the general principle that stochastic stability must account for noise are standard prior art, not claimed as novel. The genuine contribution is the direct exact invariant-axis reduction and specific violation of Wen–Mo equations (16)–(18) at the paper’s own Parameter Set 1. The source PDF was compared against its own printed stochastic model and noise-free criterion; related noise-aware Wang 2024 finance and Wang 2025 carbon-supply models do not give this specific correction.
